thesis: The episode introduces Will Thorndyke, an author and investor who founded Housatonic Partners, and discusses his book The Outsiders, which is based on an eight-year research project studying CEOs like Henry Singleton, John Malone, Tom Murphy, Catherine Graham, and Warren Buffett. The conversation highlights that these CEOs were often contrarians regarding dividends, buybacks, acquisitions, and debt, and the discussion begins to explore Thorndyke's journey from reading about Buffett to founding his private equity firm.
